technology_name: Trichoderma harzianum Mass Production on Areca Leaf Sheath
problem_solved: Need for rapid mass production of Trichoderma for eco-friendly disease management.
description: A very simple, cost-effective technology for the rapid mass production of Trichoderma harzianum (CPTD 28) utilizing areca leaf sheath. The Trichoderma enriched areca leaf sheath can be effectively utilized for the eco-friendly management of stem bleeding and basal stem rot diseases of coconut and also for quick wilt disease of black pepper.
applications: Industrial-scale manufacturing of agricultural biopesticides, Production of eco-friendly disease management inputs, Deployment in plantation crop protection programs
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
